chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim al-Mu'addab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashar from 'Ubaydallah ibn 'Abdullah al-Dahqan from Darast ibn Abi Mansur al-Wasiti from 'Abd al-Hamid ibn Abi'l 'Ala' from Thabit ibn Dinar from Sa'd ibn Turayf al-Khaffaf from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata. He said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

I am the vicegerent of the Messenger of Allah, his vizier, and his inheritor. I am the brother of the Messenger of Allah, his deputy, and his beloved. I am the elite one of the Messenger of Allah and his companion. I am the cousin of the Messenger of Allah, the husband of his daughter, and the father of his descendants. I am the Master of the Deputies and the Deputy of the Master of Prophets. I am the decisive argument, the great sign, the highest ideal, and the gate of the Chosen Prophet. I am the Firm Handle, the pious word, and the faithful of Allah - exalted is His mention - over the people of this world.

key_terms.الحجة العظمى: The greatest proof/argument - a title signifying divine authority
key_terms.العروة الوثقى: The Firm Handle - a Quranic concept (2:256) representing the unbreakable bond with God
key_terms.خليفة: Vicegerent, successor - one who carries on the role of the Prophet
key_terms.كلمة التقوى: The Word of Piety - a Quranic concept (48:26) representing the testimony of faith
key_terms.وصي: Deputy, executor of the will - the one appointed to carry out the Prophet's legacy

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual titles of Imam Ali according to al-Amali of al-Saduq?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated through a long chain from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, a devoted companion of Imam Ali (AS), the Commander of the Faithful enumerates his unique spiritual and familial titles with respect to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW). This declaration was delivered in a public gathering where Ali (AS) asserted his role as successor, brother, deputy, cousin, and son-in-law of the Prophet, as well as the Master of the Deputies, the Decisive Argument, the Great Sign, the Firm Handle, and the Trustee of God over mankind. These titles echo Quranic concepts and reflect core Shia doctrines about the Imamate.
